narrative.overview: EV-COST takes its look from the Devin product site and app, a reference the user pinned on 2026-11-10: soft off-white canvas, hairline white cards, a calm grotesk, solid ink pills and git-diff figures. The blurred backdrop appears once, behind the hero forecast card. Every derived number still shows its working, with formulas set as code lines in Geist Mono. Light is the default; dark is a separately tuned theme.
keyCharacteristics: Off-white canvas, white cards with 14px corners and hairlines.
One ink pill per view; outline pills elsewhere.
Geist UI, Geist Mono for formulas and diffs.
Signed figures as diffs in green and red.

rules.name: The One Ink Pill Rule
rules.body: Each view has at most one solid pill: its primary action.

rules.name: The Diff Rule
rules.body: Signed money is set in Geist Mono with an explicit + or −, coloured like a code diff.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Section labels are small, sentence case and muted, never uppercase eyebrows.

rules.name: The One Backdrop Rule
rules.body: The blurred backdrop appears once, behind the hero forecast card.

dos: Do keep one ink pill per view, for the primary action.
Do set signed money in Geist Mono with + or −, coloured like a diff.
Do pair every status colour with its icon and word.
Do test every new surface in both themes; tokens swap through data-theme on <html>.
Do use the validated series colours for each theme.
donts: Don't use uppercase tracked eyebrows or kickers above headings.
Don't add the blurred backdrop anywhere except the hero forecast card.
Don't hard-code colours in components; use the tokens, or dark mode breaks.
Don't use text below 12px, or monospace for anything other than formulas, diffs and key hints.
Don't add coloured side stripes, gradient text, or heavy drop shadows on resting cards.
